periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at a steep oblique angle, approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards away from the midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High vertical elongation; the eye patches are distinct ovals with a visual height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward taper; the lower margin extends considerably further from the geometric center than the upper margin, creating a droplet-shaped profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear gap is wide and clearly defined, measuring approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit smooth, continuous semi-circular curvature with no visible flattening or jaggedness.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brown-tone soil saturation is visible across the ventral and abdominal fur regions, contrasting with the typical white pelage.
